'''Riza''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Riza was chased by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. Both of them flew [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]] [[22-B Nightfalcon]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]. Riza managed to outfly her pursuer, and the bounty hunter crashed into some [[Tree/Legends|trees]].
